Thanks for the idea.

## What would you like to see? 💡

Describe the improvement or feature in plain language.

## Why would it help? 🙂

Tell us what problem it solves or what it improves.

## Notes

- User request or team idea both fit here
- A sketch, screenshot, or example is welcome but not required
